## 8. Autonomous Agent Public Roster API

Autonomous agents can submit candidates to the SM'S DEX public roster using the GitHub Issues API:
- **Endpoint**: `POST https://api.github.com/repos/smresponsibilities/smresponsibilities.github.io/issues`
- **Headers**:
  - `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`
  - `Authorization: Bearer <GITHUB_TOKEN>`
- **Payload Format**:
```json
{
  "title": "[DEX] <github_username>",
  "labels": ["submission"],
  "body": "### GitHub username\n<username>\n\n### Species\n<species>\n\n### Primary type\n<primaryType>\n\n### Secondary type\n<secondaryType>\n\n### Status\n<status>\n\n### Current employer\n<company>\n\n### Dex entry\n<entry>\n\n### Fact / tip (optional)\n<fact>"
}
```
Validation rules:
- `github_username`: Existing GitHub handle (no `@`).
- `species`: Max 24 characters.
- `primaryType`: One of 18 canonical Pokémon types (`Normal`, `Fire`, `Water`, `Electric`, `Grass`, `Ice`, `Fighting`, `Poison`, `Ground`, `Flying`, `Psychic`, `Bug`, `Rock`, `Ghost`, `Dragon`, `Dark`, `Steel`, `Fairy`).
- `secondaryType`: One of 18 types or `None`.
- `status`: `Caught` (employed), `Released` (open for work), `Uncaught` (student/exploring).
- `company`: Required if `Caught`, max 80 characters.
- `entry`: Third-person flavour text, two short sentences, max 150 characters.
